Goa Seeks Centre's Approval for Tourism Reforms and Connectivity

Goa has received approval from the central government for a trusted traveller programme. The state is also seeking enhanced air connectivity to boost its tourism sector. These initiatives aim to reform and promote sustainable tourism within the region. The approval for the trusted traveller programme was granted by the Centre, while the request for improved air connectivity is part of Goa's broader tourism strategy.
